audit_reference: 10.6 Five-Country Canonical Coverage Audit & Expansion Plan v1
note: Work packages are planning artifacts for a FUTURE 10.7 execution. This audit is read-only; no package is executed here.

packages.title: Canonical schema observability
packages.description: Expose core/catalog/taxonomy/evidence/labour/reporting/ingest to PostgREST (or add psql-based audit tooling) so canonical schemas are observable for verification.
packages.acceptance: Canonical table row counts retrievable read-only

packages.title: GB/UK naming canonicalization
packages.description: Standardize GB canonical code across fixtures (uk-* -> gb-*) with country-normalization alias maintained for backward compat.
packages.acceptance: No uk-* fixtures reference canonical GB data; normalization table remains

packages.title: Five-country raw data lineage
packages.description: Create data/raw/{au,gb,us,ca,ie} folders with tracked source snapshots (CRICOS, OfS, Scorecard, DLI, Qualifax) and un-gitignore canonical raw files; formalize import scripts.
packages.acceptance: data/raw has 5 canonical country folders; importers reference them

packages.title: US + IE occupations ingestion
packages.description: Ingest BLS SOC 2020 (+OEWS) for US occupations/occupation_state; CSO occupation codes + shortage lists for IE into taxonomy.occupations.
packages.acceptance: occupations_us and occupations_ie tables present with verified counts

packages.title: Origin-comparison table verification
packages.description: Determine whether concept_career_mappings/career_compensation_observations/housing_cost_observations/country_comparison_coverage exist in production; apply migration if missing or add observability.

packages.title: Orphan/duplicate cleanup
packages.description: Resolve DUP-001/002, ORP-001/002 (data/policy-review-required.json, kr-occupations.json, souces/ typo dir, data/raw/kr gitignore).
packages.acceptance: No orphan placeholders or duplicate source docs

packages.title: AU nursing canonical package advancement
packages.description: Advance au-nursing candidate package from B_PARTIAL to A by closing professionalOutcome/accreditation/mandatoryStudyCosts/estimatedTotalTuition gaps; reconcile 3-store duplication.
packages.acceptance: Candidate package reaches A_READY; UI fixture linked to canonical

packages.title: GB shortage + US projections enrichment
packages.description: Ingest GOV.UK shortage occupation list and BLS employment projections into evidence.metric_observations.
packages.acceptance: Shortage + projection rows present with source_register_records lineage
